name: check_stock
description: Check quantity of an item in a specific store

name: find_stores_with_item
description: Find stores with quantity > 0 for an item and size

name: suggest_transfer
description: Suggest, never execute, moving stock from one store to another for human approval. Use this only when the customer's requested store is out of stock (check_stock = 0) and another store has the item in stock. Do not use this when the requested store already has stock, and do not execute the transfer yourself.
